name: Teak Outdoor Armchair – Aluminium Frame with Plastic Wood Slats
material: Alul frame powder coated + plastic wood
description: This outdoor armchair features a lightweight alu frame with a durable powder-coated finish, making it ideal for all-weather use. The seat, backrest, and armrests are crafted from plastic wood slats that provide the natural look of wood with added resistance to moisture, fading, and cracking. and weighing just 12 pounds, it's easy to move and perfect for patios, balconies, or outdoor dining areas. Built to blend comfort, durability, and modern style, this chair is a practical choice for any outdoor space.
